verdict.rationale: Slack's own docs confirm threads exist as a conversation unit (AI can summarize channels and threads), and community users describe thread replies in practice, which confirms side discussions attach to messages. Community complaints about thread usability, such as notifications and limited snippet/file support, are limitations rather than contradictions. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explicitly describing replying in threads to an original message, detail on thread behavior and controls, and evidence for any admin-specific thread handling.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can reply in threads so side discussions stay attached to the original message

citations.quote: AI in Slack can summarize channels and threads
